# `PlateSolve`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Plate-solve begin/progress/result, from the direct solve sender and the function-state detail.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (observation only) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, SendSolveEvent @0x200fe0 (64-bit build), StartSolve @0x1fb9f0 (64-bit build); F family helpers |

Two producers share the name. Direct solve notifier sends start, solving, complete or fail with page, tag and, depending on the branch, star_number, duration_ms, filename, result, target_ra_dec, and error/code on failure, plus caller extension-map members (keys unresolved; tolerate unknown members). The F detail follows the function-state family: Function-state family (F): the event formatter formats the named function detail. state is always present; stage only when non-empty; lapse_ms while the timer runs or at a terminal state; error and code at fail (even when the stored code is zero; lookup failure gives 'fail to operate'); cancel omits code and error; route is optional function ancestry. The sender does no deduplication and needs no preceding working event. Detail flags can suppress the working or non-working sends while the cached function tree still changes, so a receiver can miss transitions. Duration and cadence are work-dependent. Channel I (TCP 4700). Delivery: ordinary broadcast to every retained socket of the emitting server (master, guest and never-verified sockets alike); no cadence, delivery or ordering guarantee relative to RPC replies or other events. APK 3.3.2 consumes it (a route containing 3PPA is special-cased).

Side effects: Observation only for the receiver.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"PlateSolve"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `state` | string | yes | - | Union of two producers. F: idle, working, complete, fail, cancel. Direct solve notifier: start, solving, complete, fail. One of: `idle`, `working`, `complete`, `fail`, `cancel`, `start`, `solving`. [READ] |
| `stage` | string | if stage string non-empty | - | Only when the detail holds a non-empty stage string; value set unresolved. [READ] |
| `lapse_ms` | integer | if timer started (working) or terminal state | - | Elapsed milliseconds (signed 32-bit low bits): current monotonic time minus start while working or started-but-unfinished, otherwise end minus start. Independent of Timestamp. [READ] |
| `error` | string | if state is fail (F or direct failure lookup) | - | Message for code. [READ] |
| `code` | integer | if state is fail (F or direct failure lookup) | - | Stored error code; present at fail even when zero. [READ] |
| `route` | array<string> | no | - | Function-ancestry names at send time (for example View, Stack); may be absent. Not an address. [READ] |
| `page` | string | if direct producer | - | Direct producer: current page. [READ] |
| `tag` | string | if direct producer | - | Direct producer: source tag. [READ] |
| `star_number` | integer | if progress/result with count | - | Star count, only when available. [READ] |
| `duration_ms` | integer | if direct result | - | Solve duration in milliseconds. [READ] |
| `filename` | string | if input file present | - | Input image path when solving a stored image. [READ] |
| `result` | object | if result branch | - | Solver result branch. [READ] |
| `result.ra_dec` | array<number> | no | - | Solved centre [RA, Dec], RA in hours (solver degrees divided by 15) and Dec in degrees (as in get_solve_result). For start_solve referred to the equinox of date (JNow); the block-solve path takes this choice from its caller and otherwise keeps J2000. Range: at least 2 item(s). [READ] |
| `result.fov` | array<number> | no | - | Field of view [width, height] in degrees (solver arcminute or arcsecond output divided by 60 or 3600). Range: at least 2 item(s). [READ] |
| `result.focal_len` | number | no | - | Focal length implied by the solved field, the sensor pixel size and the binning (max image dimension x bin x pixel size / 1000 / max field in radians); stored only when it is between 0 and 1000. Millimetres INFERRED (assumes pixel size in micrometres). [READ (formula and bound); unit INFERRED] |
| `result.angle` | number | no | - | Field rotation in degrees, within -180..180; east of north INFERRED. [READ (unit and normalisation)] |
| `result.image_id` | integer | no | - | Solved image id. [READ] |
| `target_ra_dec` | array<number> | if target-coordinate branch | - | Target coordinate pair (target-coordinate branch). Range: at least 2 item(s). [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, complete - Solve result (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"PlateSolve","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"complete","page":"preview","tag":"example","star_number":214,"duration_ms":1830,"result":{"ra_dec":[5.5,22.0],"fov":[0.7,1.3],"focal_len":250.0,"angle":12.5,"image_id":41}}
```

Event, fail - Solve failure (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"PlateSolve","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"fail","page":"preview","tag":"example","error":"example error","code":207}
```
